Name: Ilucie's Mini Pigs
Author: IlucieYt
Description:
Mini Pigs dig up White Truffles, that can be processed into White Truffle Oil.
Just like the vanilla Truffles, White truffles also benefit from the botanist perk.

You can purchase this little falle at Marnie's <3.

This mod is compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23228]Better Truffles[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720/?tab=posts&jump_to_comment=137695200]Machine Progression System[/url]



The sprite is based on the Ragnarok Online Monster Savage Babe :)
